hooks.logic:
Count up "currentTurn".
Let conditionFlagInFrame be condition flag v2 is up this frame.
Let conditionFlagInFrame2 be condition flag v3 is up this frame.
If conditionFlagInFrame or conditionFlagInFrame2, then
  Set the register's 'isFly' to not not conditionFlagInFrame2.
  Reset the count "currentTurn".
  Set the register's 'changeParamHp' to 0.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
Let v5 be list.
Let v6 be list2.
If not the register's 'isFly', then
  Set v5 to list2.
  Set v6 to list.
Let currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo be the phase matching the current form of the enemy under the phases v5.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for the enemy under the phases v5.
Let paramSuffixNo be v6 at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'paramSuffixNo'.
Let number be the numeric entry v5 at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'damageRateAiArg' in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Let v7 be the value "maxHp" of the enemy times number divided by 100.
If v5 at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'paramSuffixNo' is not paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs, then
  The enemy changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  The enemy cancels its cast.
Let resultObjectsInFrame be the results v4 this frame.
If the length of resultObjectsInFrame is more than 0, then
  For each x in resultObjectsInFrame, add x's 'damage' to the register's 'changeParamHp'.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let v8 be unset.
  Let number2 be the numeric entry v5 at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'firstTurnAbility' in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
  Let number3 be the numeric entry v5 at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'everyTurnAbility' in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
  If the count "currentTurn" is more than number2, then
    If (the count "currentTurn" minus number2) mod number3 equals 0, then the enemy uses the move labelled v5 at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'abilityTagForTurn' and stop.
  Otherwise, if the count "currentTurn" is number2, then the enemy uses the move labelled v5 at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'abilityTagForTurn' and stop.
  If v7 is at most the register's 'changeParamHp', then
    Set v8 to the id of the move labelled v5 at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'abilityTag' on the enemy.
    Call helper with (this state, v8, paramSuffixNo) and stop.
  If the count "currentTurn" is less than the numeric entry v5 at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'abilityTurnAiArg' in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then
    Let excludedAbilityListBySmartLot be the enemy → get-excluded-ability-list-by-smart-lot.
    Append (the id of the move labelled v5 at currentBpIdxByCurrentParamSuffixNo's 'abilityTag' on the enemy) to excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
    Set v8 to a weighted random move of the enemy other than excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
  Otherwise, set v8 to a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
  If v8 is the id of the move labelled "assault_drop" on the enemy or v8 is the id of the move labelled "offensive_move" on the enemy, then call helper with (this state, v8, paramSuffixNo).
  Otherwise, the enemy uses v8.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg1, arg2, arg3.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg1.
Let list3 be [[{builtin: "CHANGE_PARAM", paramSuffixNo: arg3}]].
If arg2 is the id of the move labelled "offensive_move" on executer, then
  Let bundle be call game:StatusAilmentsConfig.getBundle with (game:Conf.STATUS_AILMENTS_BUNDLE.ESNA).
  Let bundle2 be call game:StatusAilmentsConfig.getBundle with (game:Conf.STATUS_AILMENTS_BUNDLE.PARAM_BOOST_DISPEL).
  Set list3 to list3 → concat with ([[{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: bundle, saChildNos: [1]}], [{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: bundle2, saChildNos: [1]}]]).
Executer uses arg2 with its cast time followed by [{abilityId: arg2}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: list3}}].
